CustomField.description: Date the last stalled-deal reminder was sent for this deal. Read together with Stage_Alert_Stage__c, its required companion snapshot - this field alone cannot tell whether the reminder should re-fire, because a stage change re-arms it independently of how recent this date is. Written by StageDelayAlertBatch in system mode.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by the daily stalled-deal reminder job. The date the deal was last reminded on for sitting in its current stage.
CustomField.label: Stage Alert Last Sent Date
